name: Shangshui Smartech Ltd.
summary: Shangshui Smartech Ltd. engages in the research, design, production, and sales of intelligent equipment integrating process capabilities. The company offers intelligent equipment for manufacturing new energy battery electrode sheets, including high-speed film dispersion and pulping system, circulating high-efficiency pulping system, kneading-type high-efficiency pulping system, twin-screw pulping system, coating system, and roller pressing and slitting system.
